title: Safeguarded ephemeral admin sandboxlet for runbooks-as-tasks
creator: Ari Mendoza
description:
Summary: Build an ephemeral, credentialed admin 'sandboxlet' that can execute runbook steps as isolated tasks for support engineers and oncall. The sandboxlet provides a reproducible dry-run mode, step-level playback with telemetry, and short-lived credentials (KMS/HSM-wrapped) so that support can validate remediation flows without touching production state.

Goals: - Allow safe execution of runbook fragments against a replayed or simulated environment. - Provide per-step cost & latency estimation prior to real execution. - Enforce RBAC and approval gating for elevated operations. - Persist a provenance record (immutable) for audits and postmortems.

Non-goals: - Do not replace full production runbook execution path; this is a safety-first simulation+staging surface. - Not implementing full chaos-injection in v1.

Architecture notes: - Each sandboxlet instantiates a short-lived credential envelope (KMS-wrapped keys) scoped to exactly the resources referenced by the runlet. - Actions run inside isolated containers with strict egress and API call allowlists. - Step-level KV/state snapshots allow deterministic replay; we capture and redact PII by default. - A cost estimator runs a token/CPU/memory simulation for each step and surfaces an estimated cost delta. - Telemetry traces include token counts, external call signatures, latency percentiles, and a small semantic diff for output shape changes.

Acceptance criteria: - Support engineer can create a sandboxlet from an existing runbook fragment in the Console and run a dry-run with a simulated dataset. - Sandbox run produces an audit record with: runlet id, step timeline, estimated cost, and a pointer to the ephemeral credential envelope. - RBAC gating prevents runs above P2 operations without explicit approval. - Telemetry dashboard shows sandbox runs separately and includes a regression alert hook to the Optimize pipeline.

Design trade-offs considered: - Full mimicry of production networking vs. strict allowlist: we chose allowlist to reduce blast radius and simplify compliance. - Automatic fallback to production variant on failure: deferred to later to avoid accidental production escalation.

Open questions: - What retention window for ephemeral credentials balances usability and security? Proposal: 15 minutes by default, extendable with audited approvals. - How deterministic should the cost estimator be for tokenized LLM calls vs. real runtime variability?

Artifacts: - Confluence: https://confluence.internal/redwood/ops-sandboxlet-v1 (prototype spec) - Prototype UI mocks: https://drive.internal/redwood/ops-sandboxlet-mocks/v1 - Cost estimator toy: https://github.com/redwood/ops-sandboxlet/tree/estimator-proto
comments: 2026-01-22 - Priya: Initial spike complete. Prototype can spin a container and attach a KMS-wrapped ephemeral key. Verified container allowlist prevents external SSH. Next: integrate with runbook DSL extractor.

2026-01-29 - Security review (first pass) by Marco Li: flagged data retention and KMS wrapping patterns. Recommended redaction pipeline for environment snapshots + mandatory key rotation. Added security_review_required=true on ticket.
2026-02-05 - Design feedback from Dana (Design): suggested step-level UX with 'preview cost' and inline approvals. Mock updated in Drive: ops-sandboxlet-mocks/v1/preview-cost.png

2026-02-12 - Eng sync: decided to gate high-priv runs behind an approvals microflow (PM endpoint + console modal). Trade-off: introduces latency for urgent oncall flows; mitigation: emergency bypass available to SREs with extra logging.
2026-02-20 - PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/platform/pull/4892 - sandboxlet: bootstrap ephemeral credentials and containerization. Requesting review from infra and security.
2026-02-24 - QA note: dry-run output redaction failing on nested JSON keys in a noisy dataset. Created follow-up ENG-574999 to add recursive-redact util.
2026-03-03 - PM note (Elena Ortiz): add metric hooks for runlet success rate and pre-run acceptance rate. Link to dashboard draft: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/ops-sandboxlet-v1

2026-03-08 - Implementation update: step-level telemetry is wired; cost estimator currently uses sampled model profiles and is accurate within 20% for our test corpus. We need a smaller estimator variance before GA.

2026-03-10 - Blocker discovered: some third-party APIs called in sandboxlet still require prod-scoped API keys. Mitigation plan: virtualize external APIs for sandbox runs OR require per-API allowlist entries and token substitution. See dependency ENG-314572 for the virtual API shim work.

2026-03-10 - Next steps: complete recursive-redact util (ENG-574999), finish approvals modal, tighten estimator variance, and schedule security re-review after KMS rotation flow implemented. Target for merge to staging branch: 2026-03-24.
